sentences: How much does the repair cost?
I will send you a quote today.

grammar.title: Comparativos de preço e qualidade: cheaper vs. more expensive
rules: Adjetivos curtos ganham -er: cheap → cheaper (mais barato), fast → faster (mais rápido).
Adjetivos longos usam more antes: expensive → more expensive, reliable → more reliable.
Use than para comparar duas opções: "This part is cheaper than the original."
